## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D platform adventure inspired by Super Bear Adventure for PC and Android.

## Requirements
- Support PC and Android, including keyboard and touch controls.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Created an original game, “Brave Bear & the Sunseeds,” with a custom Three.js bear and sky-island platform course.
- Gameplay goal: collect eight Sunseeds and reach the summit gate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` with responsive UI, keyboard/touch controls, jumping, collectibles, checkpoints, pause/restart, and win state.
- Verified `node --check game.js` passes.
- Opened the game in Playwright and confirmed the 3D scene renders.

### Active
- Investigate and fix a gameplay issue: a brief W-key test ended with “Whoops! Back to the last island.”; movement/jump/platform traversal needs validation and likely adjustment.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect jump and platform collision behavior in `game.js`; test traversing the island gaps with keyboard and touch.
2. Recheck the rendered game and console after changes.
3. Stop the local test server when finished; changes are uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, physics, input, collectibles, checkpoints, and game state.
- `index.html`: Game UI and overlays.
- `style.css`: Responsive styling and mobile touch-control layout.
- `screenshots/playing.png`: Captured gameplay scene.

## Important Context
- Playwright showed the game rendering successfully; its only console error was a missing `/favicon.ico`.
- `playwright-cli` browser was installed for testing; local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The W-key test screenshot showed the fall/recovery toast, so controls or jump/platform collision need further testing.
